Peter, I was born and raised right in Rockford. I’m not a career politician, I’m just a guy who cares about Central and Northwestern Illinois, our families, our neighbors, and our world. I will never take for granted the honor you’ve placed in me to do this job. And being the only person in Congress without politics in my pedigree, I am thankful I have the ability to work however I can best support my neighbors, my district, when others can’t. In fact, here's a story: I was doing my shopping at the grocery store in Moline, and as I was going through the butcher’s section I had a chance encounter with a woman doing her family shopping: She asked, _“Are you my Congressman?”_ I said, _“Yes ma'am, I am.”_ She explained the concerns of what she was seeing on Fox News, and I nodded along. But then she said something you might not expect: _“I am really glad the way you voted with the farmers.”_ I smiled. Bridging the gap between differing perspectives is an essential part of my job. She followed up, _“And you support our troops and veterans too, don’t you?”_ I nodded again. _“Yes, ma’am.”_ She smiled and said, _“I think I’m gonna vote for you again.”_ **Ultimately, in our district and around the country, we want the same things, like for working families to have the resources they need to thrive, and the ability to live in safe neighborhoods with reliable infrastructure, and affordable goods.** My purpose is to continue engaging in conversations, and delivering on our community's needs to build a path forward to keeping IL-17 blue for a long time. **Unfortunately, the truth is we're seeing an uptick in spending by Republican super PACs as we move throughout the summer. * * *
**The Big Picture**

Republicans have complete control of the federal government and they are abusing it. We have watched this administration cut Medicaid, slash food assistance and hand billionaires a tax break while a rubber-stamp Republican Congress has refused to provide any meaningful oversight or accountability.

The only way to change that is to take back the House. And now that the Supreme Court has struck down the Voting Rights Act, Republicans are redrawing maps in their favor across the country. We cannot afford to give up a single seat we have. NY-04 is one of them.

Where Things Stand
* **This district is one of the most competitive in the country.** Laura won her last race by 2 points. Republicans have spent every day since then preparing to take it back.
* **National Republicans are spending $18.6 million on ads in New York.** They see NY-04 as one of their best opportunities to protect their House majority. The NRCC has been targeting this district for months.
* **The GOP have their candidate.** Laura's opponent recently launched her campaign and has already declared that she expects to be added to the MAGA Majority list and is eager to earn Trump's endorsement. She is backed by Anthony D'Esposito, who lost to Laura in 2024 and has made clear he wants this seat back in Republican hands.

**What’s at Stake**

If Republicans flip this seat, they'll have an even stronger grip on the House and a clearer path to push their extreme agenda. But if we hold it, Democrats are one step closer to taking back the House — and exposing the corruption, chaos, and abuses of power that have defined this Republican Congress.

**What Laura Needs**

We’re building the infrastructure now to win, but it’s going to take consistent support to stay competitive. The next few months are critical to:
* Fund our field and voter contact programs
* Counter GOP attack ads already running in the district
* Build the resources needed to compete against national Republican spending

We’re interrupting your Saturday morning to humbly ask you to make a contribution.

But not everyone donates. That’s why it’s so important that you do, if you can.

I love meeting Ohioans, both two- and four-legged. 🐕
On the campaign trail, I make a point to stop and pet every dog I can. I love dogs, but I also love meeting their families and owners. And sometimes, the conversations I have over a game of fetch can be some of the most enlightening and memorable moments – I hear directly about the hardships Ohioans are facing and the leadership they want to see from their senators.

body:

| |
# DNC Organizer Bootcamps
---
| |
We’re excited to share a new training opportunity from the Democratic National Committee: the **When We Count Organizer Bootcamps** , a program designed for graduating college seniors and aspiring young professionals seeking their _first_ campaign job as an organizer for the 2026 midterms.**** These train-to-hire bootcamps will train the next generation of organizers and place them in battleground campaigns across the nation.

[Bootcamps will be hosted virtually to maximize impact](https://us.list-manage.com/RbmBNZXXP7L?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e), provide accessible options to attendees, and support coordinated campaigns and state parties.
The first **virtual bootcamp is scheduled for June 25 and 26 from 10 a.m. - 5 p.m. ET**.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/yCHVVm2vACT?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)
| [APPLY HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/10pWCol9y64?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)
---
| |
Upon the completion of each bootcamp, the DNC will directly share attendees’ resumes with battleground campaigns staffing up for critical roles in the midterms.
We will host a **virtual information session** to answer questions about the Organizer Bootcamps on **June 17 at 3 p.m. ET / 12 p.m. PT.** [Register on Zoom for the session](https://us.list-manage.com/Bd9D3nBwVn1?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).
This is a wonderful opportunity for young people looking to get involved with politics for the first time! **We would love your support in amplifying the program and recruiting applicants.** Thank you for your continued support, and let me know if you have any questions!
---

American pride never fell among republicans during the Biden or Obama years while it absolutely has cratered for democrats during the Trump years. It climbed to 62% during the Biden years, but for republicans held solid at 84%. The modern left conflates country with party, America with elections, national pride with political power. That is devastating. That is tragic.
America is so much more than any president, and I wholeheartedly believe President Donald Trump would be the first to say so. Our soccer tourists, who up until now have only experienced America via movies, TV, news, and TikTok nonsense, are experiencing the America we in the right know and love: the vastness, the goodness, the kindness, the beauty, the abundance, the over-the-top-ness, the culture, the values, and most of all, the freedom.
How do we get democrats to take a road trip?
Our blue cities are a vicious cycle of one-party failure, from one-party power, with one-party promises in one-party elections causing urban misery, decline and decay, with one-party pointing to a third-party culprit. Minneapolis riots are Trump's fault. Seattle violence is Trump's fault. New York City failures are... Israel's fault. Washington, DC's filth is Congress' fault. That our inner-city school kids are functionally illiterate is... _shakes the magic eight ball_ ... Elon Musk's fault! Blame the billionaires. Blame the Jews. Just don't blame the one party that has all the power.
Those cities are magnets for party lunatics who want party power, and every election they move further left. They even now have eschewed "progressive" and fully embrace "democratic socialist" proudly. Darializa Chevaliar, a Dominican who was raised in Venezuela, has [openly screamed](https://substack.com/redirect/3daa40c0-7408-40c4-b7ef-cc4bcd02c61a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "Communism Now!" and she is, of course, a leading candidate for an open Congressional seat because why not.
Darializa hates America because she does not know America. She knows Latin and South America and a region of New York City full of Latin and South Americans, legal and illegal aliens, a region that is jam-packed with government housing, garbage strewn sidewalks, smog, crime, noise, car alarms, gun violence, gangs, and Columbia University. Of course she wants to dismantle and tear down and blah blah blah all the clenched, raised fist, crappy slogans we hear.
I wish she could see America. I wish she could have her Freddy moment. I wish they all could.
We have a city problem, but Freddy and his many World Cup travelers are elsewhere. They arrived in a major metropolitan airport, but they are on road trips seeing national parks, Bass Pro Shops, and Cracker Barrels. How many tourists go to Auburn, Alabama? Freddy went to see Germany plan, and along the way, he found America.
We have a city problem, and it is sadly spreading.
It is the cities who have elected us the most un-American Congress in history, and those people will ruin America for the rest of us. The cultural war festers in cities: defund the police, trans adults in women's locker rooms, abolish the 2nd Amendment, abolish ICE, no school choice, tax the rich... these are the ideas of an angry people living on top of other angry people 24/7 and full of rage.
Touch grass. That's the expression the kids use these days. It means, yes, go outside and connect with nature, but more fully, connect with what is real, organic, alive, and fresh. The left needs to touch grass. I'll even let them touch my grass in my fields, let them walk among the sheep and cows, get a little dirt, not just filth, on their sandals, and see how great America is. How good. How quiet. How calm. How peaceful.
They may never return.
I certainly don't want any more neighbors out my way, but I would much rather more patriots in the country than more progressives in the city. The patriots will leave me alone. The progressives are coming for me, coming for all of us, unless we give them some sort of antidote: the American experience. The Freddy. The great trip out of the city, across the country to see America and fall in love with her either again or for the first time.
And kudos to you. All of you. It was you Freddy met along the way. It was you who made him feel welcomed. You, the Americans, who made Freddy love America. Keep it going.
**Honor and courage.**

Peter — Trump and
MAGA extremists will do anything in their power to silence the Squad.

They’ve made it crystal clear: attack them, threaten them, demonize them,
and drain them. Do whatever it takes to stop Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan,
and Rashida from speaking truth to power.

It’s not working.

The Squad has never stayed quiet in the face of injustice. Not when Trump
unleashed ICE into our streets and came for immigrants. Not when this
administration targets LGBTQ+ communities. Not when extremists try to drag
this country backward and undo decades of progress.

Our progressive champions have fought back every single time, and they're
not stopping now. But these attacks are escalating, and they come with a
real cost.

Violent threats fueled by MAGA extremists and amplified by Trump's allies
don't just put the Squad at risk — they put their families, staff, and
communities in danger too. And right now, the Squad is being forced to
spend enormous resources on security just to safely show up and do their
jobs.

That's money that should be going toward organizing at the grassroots
level, mobilizing our communities, and fighting for working people.

This is exactly what Trump is counting on. If he makes the attacks vicious
enough, the Squad gets buried under the weight of just staying safe — and
they won't have the resources to fight back.

We refuse to let that happen. With this grassroots movement behind them,
we can make sure the Squad stays safe, stays in office, and keeps fighting
for the people who need them most.

On Friday morning over 600 hundred Louisianans showed up to the Louisiana state capitol to protest and speak out against a new Congressional map proposed by the Louisiana GOP that will erase Louisiana's two black majority districts and establish all white districts.
During the hearing on redistricting, GOP State Senator Jay Morris yelled "Shut up, boy" to my Executive Director Dadrius Lanus, a Black man, who, in Sen. Morris’s words was “commenting and talking” too loudly for him to concentrate.
Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and we know what it means to be called “Boy.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Senator Morris says we misheard. That the audio proves it. That he said “you all need to shut up” to the Black constituents behind him outraged that their votes won't be counted.
Senator Morris, an elected member of our legislature, thinks if he had yelled “you all need to shut up” it would be better.
It wouldn't.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that White people have been telling Black folk to “shut up" for over 250 years.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that we remember being told we were 3/5ths of a person. That even when we won personhood in the eyes of the law, they instituted poll taxes and “reading” tests. That when we marched and dreamed and cried and buried loved ones who had hung as strange fruit from tall trees because they raised their voices too loud that what Black people have always wanted is equality.
Or maybe Senator Morris does understand all that.
I don’t know.
What I do know is that I am a 70 year old Black man. And I don’t let anyone call me or my brothers “Boy.”
Please, chip in $10 or more today split between the Louisiana Democrats and Resist Reclaim Rebuild. Let’s show them that they may have gutted the Voting Rights Act and canceled our election, but we will not be silenced. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]

Thank you for coming to Louisiana’s aid in our time of crisis.

Patriot,
Flanked by the Acting Attorney General at DOJ headquarters, DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin just stood before cameras, stone-faced but emotional, and said it plainly:
_**"As a father of six, three of them young girls, I’ll do whatever it takes. I’ll move heaven and hell to go find these kids.”** _
He laid out in horrific detail the tragic fate of **at least 450,000 children** – from their journey to our previously broken border to their transfer to unvetted sponsors.
Over a third of the females, regardless of age, were reportedly sexually assaulted before they even reached the border.
And once here, **65,605 reports of abuse and neglect were filed and left to sit** – among them, 7,346 reports of human trafficking. __**Ignored.** _ _
Some of these children reported being raped **over 600 times.**
"Neglect at best, criminal at worst," as Secretary Mullin called it.
**146,000 have been located so far, but hundreds of thousands are still unaccounted for.**
These are not statistics – _they are children_.
I don't share this to politicize things, or to paralyze you. I share it because it demands a response.
My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine special operator with over 19 years of service and 15 overseas deployments both in the military and private contracting, and I’m writing to you today as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, medical professionals and everyday people committed to being the hands and feet of Jesus Christ.**
Since 2026 began, we have conducted **anti-trafficking operations across 11 states** and as you read this, we’re deployed – boots on the ground – working as a quick reaction force alongside trusted local partners for the World Cup – a magnet for trafficking the scale of which we’ve never seen. **Already we’ve rescued 14 trafficking victims leading to multiple arrests.**
The skills that made our operators effective in combat overseas – surveillance, network mapping, moving through hostile environments, finding people who do not want to be found – are exactly the skills we’re now putting to use to find vulnerable young women and children.
**We know how to find them and bring them home –** _**but we need your prayers and support.** _

name: Raja Krishnamoorthi
subject: “I would like to report a foreign occupier”
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
I want to tell you something that’s not easy to talk about...
A sitting Republican elected official recently tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media and wrote: "I would like to report a foreign occupier. Name: Unpronounceable. Country of origin: Tatooine." He was talking about me. The same official called for the mass deportation of Indian Americans.
I was born in New Delhi. I came to this country as a baby. I grew up in Peoria, Illinois. I went to public schools, got on food stamps for a time with my family, worked my way to Princeton and Harvard Law. I served in government. I got elected to Congress four times.
And someone still looked at all of that and saw a foreign occupier.
I'm telling you this not for sympathy. I'm telling you this because what happened to me is happening to communities all across this country right now, at a scale we have never seen before.
Trump and his MAGA allies have made it clear: if you weren't born here, if your name is hard to pronounce, if you look different or pray differently, you are not fully American in their eyes. They are using the machinery of the federal government to make that point, loudly and cruelly, every single day.
My father came here with nothing. He believed this country would be there for families like ours. It was. Barely. Because people fought for it.
That is exactly why I started Equal Opportunity Now.
We need leaders in office who will stand up for immigrant families and for every community that Trump has decided to make an enemy.
Those leaders exist. They are running for office right now. They need our support.
Will you chip in $25 or $50 today to help Equal Opportunity Now back the leaders who won't back down? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE NOW! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
It’s on us to stop the rising tide of MAGA Extremism. And with your help? We’ll be unstoppable.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder, Equal Opportunity Now
Visit Our Website To Learn More! [https://www.equalopportunitynow.org/]

Equal Opportunity Now is d/b/a Reviving American Jobs Again PAC (RAJA PAC)

P.O. Box 68412,
Schaumburg, IL 60168
United States

I got elected to Congress four times. And someone still looked at all of that and saw a foreign occupier. I'm telling you this not for sympathy. I'm telling you this because what happened to me is happening to communities all across this country right now, at a scale we have never seen before. Trump and his MAGA allies have made it clear: if you weren't born here, if your name is hard to pronounce, if you look different or pray differently, you are not fully American in their eyes. They are using the machinery of the federal government to make that point, loudly and cruelly, every single day. My father came here with nothing. He believed this country would be there for families like ours. It was. Barely. Because people fought for it. That is exactly why I started Equal Opportunity Now. We need leaders in office who will stand up for immigrant families and for every community that Trump has decided to make an enemy. Those leaders exist. They are running for office right now. They need our support. Will you chip in $25 or $50 today to help Equal Opportunity Now back the leaders who won't back down? [] DONATE NOW! [] It’s on us to stop the rising tide of MAGA Extremism. And with your help? We’ll be unstoppable. — Raja Krishnamoorthi Founder, Equal Opportunity Now Visit Our Website To Learn More! I want to say something I can’t say nearly enough: **thank you.**

I've been in public service for a long time. Some days are hard, enraging, even heartbreaking. But what keeps me in the fight is the people standing behind me.

That's you. The supporters who chip in their hard-earned dollars. The folks who stay engaged and show up — even when the news makes it tempting to check out.

**I don't take any of it for granted.**

Here's what your support means in real terms: organizers on the ground in every corner of Virginia, ads reaching persuadable voters before the other side does and spreading the message of how we’re going to make life better for everyone, and the campaign infrastructure we need to actually compete when November comes. Supporters like you are what make all of that possible.

And frankly, what happens this November matters beyond any one race. __Virginia is a majority-maker.__ We have several competitive House seats right here in the Commonwealth that, alongside this Senate seat, could determine who controls Congress. The battle for the House and Senate runs through Virginia. And when we win in November, it will be because of grassroots donors like you.

[_**So, if you are in a position to donate, will you consider your first $5 today? The fight continues,

name: Wes Moore
subject: This is an email about saying goodbye.
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1524%2E1086043%2EU5KlCp)
This is a longer email about saying goodbye, Peter, but if you don’t have time to read through, I would deeply appreciate **[a contribution to power our campaign.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260620-1.OKCb9Q&refcode=em-20260620-1&t=2&akid=1524%2E1086043%2EU5KlCp)**
After nearly a century of operation, Valley Forge Military Academy — the place where I went to school and grew from an angry, complicated child to a confident young man — has closed.
When my mother first sent me to the Forge, she saw military school as a last resort in response to a seemingly endless chain of misbehavior, both at home and at school. At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. **I was not on a path to success.**
There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions — and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets.
After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland _and the first Black governor in the history of my state._
What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me.
**It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success.**
Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement.
I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today.
That includes the **Maryland Corps and Service Year Option** — the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career.
We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. **[If you support that mission, I would appreciate a donation to keep me in the fight as Maryland's governor today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260620-1.OKCb9Q&refcode=em-20260620-1&t=3&akid=1524%2E1086043%2EU5KlCp)**
Elevate,
Wes
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260620-1.OKCb9Q&refcode=em-20260620-1&t=4&akid=1524%2E1086043%2EU5KlCp)
_Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform do not imply endorsement from the Department of Defense._

* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-footer?refcode=em-20260620-1&t=5&refcode2=1524_1086043_U5KlCp&akid=1524%2E1086043%2EU5KlCp)**
**[Volunteer »](https://support.wesmoore.com/a/volunteer?source=em-20260620-1)**

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Peter, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you. The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct. Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage. I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back. In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won. Ken Paxton can win this race. President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that. Texas is not going to flip because the Democrats got lucky. It will only flip if we let them. Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House P.S. | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | |

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hey folks,
Happy Father’s Day weekend to all of the dads, father figures, single parents, uncles, grandpas, and advocates out there!
I wanted to give a special shoutout to my father, David Bertrand, today. Other than my husband, my dad is my best friend. He’s always let me know I could do anything if I worked hard for it—he even supported me when I decided I wanted to be a pro wrestler, which was a short-lived dream.
My dad showed me a type of leadership that is rarely seen but is truly special. It is strong yet soft, it is oriented around giving to others instead of serving yourself. My dad also taught me about generosity. He has a heart for giving without ever expecting anything in return. Over the years, he has carved his name on so many hearts. He is always sought after by friends, family, and even old colleagues for his wisdom, ability to mediate and solve problems, and just for a listening ear.
So much of me is a product of my dad—from my values to my hobbies, to my ability to change a flat tire, my own oil, fix (minor) plumbing issues, pull wire and install new electrical outlets, and even how important eating a half of an avocado daily is to staying regular.
My dad has been there for every chapter of my life, big and small. He was my first contribution on this campaign. He helps deliver signs, he talks to voters, and he is 100% committed to building a brighter future for his grandkids.
Fun fact: my dad, husband, brother, father-in-law, and oldest son are all named David.
My dad is doing everything he can to support me and help our campaign because he believes that everyone deserves a chance at healthcare, dignified working conditions, and to provide for their families—just like he did for his. If you share that vision, a contribution today would mean a great deal to our team. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260620_Dad_act]

After twenty years of the same leadership in Washington, families are still living paycheck to paycheck. People in my generation are no closer to owning a home. Folks still can't afford a doctor's visit.

The squeeze working families are feeling didn't just happen. It was enabled by establishment politicians who stopped showing up for working families a long time ago.

I know this squeeze because I live it. My neighbors -- whether they vote Democrat, Republican, or have no party affiliation -- know it too. We don't have the luxury of waiting for things to get better on their own.

That's why we fought so hard to get here. And that's why November matters so much.

name: Paul Barringer
subject: Hey, I’m Paul and I’m running for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Paul Barringer for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=onboarding [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=onboarding]
Paul Barringer headshot [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/118244/images/PBHeadshotCircle.png]
Peter,
My name is Paul Barringer, and I’m the Democrat running for Congress in North Carolina’s 13th Congressional District – which, if you look at the map, basically looks like something trying to eat the Triangle.
NC's 13th Congressional District [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/118244/images/gerrymonster.png]
If you don’t know me, I’m a husband, father, lawyer, Eagle Scout, and trail runner. I live on the same farm in Lee County that my family has had since the 1800s. I’ve taught Sunday school for the last twenty years, and I’m a big fan of fried chicken and lentils.
Throughout my career, I’ve worked at the intersection of health care, law, technology, and government to make programs work better for the people they serve and to solve problems by bringing people together, not dividing them.
I’m running for Congress because, honestly, we need different representation. Maybe like you, I’ve been dismayed by current events over the last year - and I think we need a different, better direction for our country. All our current rep offers is more of the same.
What will I offer? I believe in practical solutions rooted in constitutional principles, fiscal responsibility, local control, and common-sense health and justice reforms. I believe in caring for others, personal responsibility, and public service. And I believe in the importance of an independent Congress that will stand up to party bosses, big corporations, and billionaires – including Donald Trump.
I also believe that we can disagree with others without being disrespectful. If elected, I will seek to develop consensus on practical solutions to address challenges in healthcare, education, and other areas.
It seems pretty clear that the General Assembly created District 13 to try to keep Democrats out of office. If we're going to be successful in this district, we're going to have to attract independents and some crossover voters. With the right person and platform, I believe that's possible. BUT... to turn District 13 blue, we need resources.
I’m prepared to put in the time and energy to raise the money to run a competitive campaign, but I can only win this race with your support. This is going to be a grassroots campaign from one end of the district to the other, and I hope I can count on you to become a part of it today. clean_body: [] Paul Barringer headshot [] Peter, My name is Paul Barringer, and I’m the Democrat running for Congress in North Carolina’s 13th Congressional District – which, if you look at the map, basically looks like something trying to eat the Triangle. NC's 13th Congressional District [] If you don’t know me, I’m a husband, father, lawyer, Eagle Scout, and trail runner. I live on the same farm in Lee County that my family has had since the 1800s. I’ve taught Sunday school for the last twenty years, and I’m a big fan of fried chicken and lentils. Throughout my career, I’ve worked at the intersection of health care, law, technology, and government to make programs work better for the people they serve and to solve problems by bringing people together, not dividing them. I’m running for Congress because, honestly, we need different representation. Maybe like you, I’ve been dismayed by current events over the last year - and I think we need a different, better direction for our country. All our current rep offers is more of the same. What will I offer? I believe in practical solutions rooted in constitutional principles, fiscal responsibility, local control, and common-sense health and justice reforms. I believe in caring for others, personal responsibility, and public service. And I believe in the importance of an independent Congress that will stand up to party bosses, big corporations, and billionaires – including Donald Trump. I also believe that we can disagree with others without being disrespectful. If elected, I will seek to develop consensus on practical solutions to address challenges in healthcare, education, and other areas. It seems pretty clear that the General Assembly created District 13 to try to keep Democrats out of office. If we're going to be successful in this district, we're going to have to attract independents and some crossover voters. With the right person and platform, I believe that's possible. BUT... to turn District 13 blue, we need resources. I’m prepared to put in the time and energy to raise the money to run a competitive campaign, but I can only win this race with your support. body:
Next term, the Supreme Court will hear whether ICE can hold people indefinitely. | |
---
Peter, The Supreme Court just announced that next term, it will hear a case determining whether ICE can hold people in detention _indefinitely_. **The fact that this is even a question they would consider is proof enough of how extreme the Court has become.** ICE has been holding lawful permanent residents in detention without the ability to post bond, essentially for as long as they want. **The case before the Court concerns two green card residents, one who was held for seven months, and another who was held for 21 months. Both were denied bond hearings.** Let’s be very clear: indefinite detention with no opportunity for bond violates the right of every person in America not to be denied “life, liberty, or property without due process of law.” **But the Constitution doesn’t matter to this Administration, and the wannabe dictator in charge. clean_body: Next term, the Supreme Court will hear whether ICE can hold people indefinitely. | | Peter, The Supreme Court just announced that next term, it will hear a case determining whether ICE can hold people in detention indefinitely. The fact that this is even a question they would consider is proof enough of how extreme the Court has become. ICE has been holding lawful permanent residents in detention without the ability to post bond, essentially for as long as they want. The case before the Court concerns two green card residents, one who was held for seven months, and another who was held for 21 months. Both were denied bond hearings. Let’s be very clear: indefinite detention with no opportunity for bond violates the right of every person in America not to be denied “life, liberty, or property without due process of law.” But the Constitution doesn’t matter to this Administration, and the wannabe dictator in charge. And it clearly doesn’t matter to the captured, corrupt Supreme Court, either. The Trump administration is launching an unprecedented attack in the case. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

This week, I introduced the Find Our Families Act, which would require DHS to maintain an accurate and detailed online detainee locator system for anyone detained by ICE or CBP. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWeD3GP1AXWIiFezITTG8Q9xcVE-cNEXzeIuwmYsHILpOfw6wp-73MwfLYfjkGs3RhBcBZFlBUQGju51IDel5ZUpJeluG9e65WoOur-RnD5jSLbifWYS6H39poySJIle1SGcYxVk1HaJBCDDwgn4DmCGwjdFhQkCk81Ubaf5hd02No7tIBgXrNbeXCe2J87NfIisX3tJ5wLvej5_LPPjk5k4OOwn6UaNaUAcOvEW-3ZqCfbzkToqHX0G7u5mNm4Y47/4rn/vgUwEkq5RCe6mPeP_ybqVg/h0/h001.iIZT5_gJI0q3MNrU1IYr-kXDKCErhh7F-OMnk7MeGOs)
---
Friend, ICE and Border Patrol are abducting our neighbors, locking them in cages, and concealing their location from their families and legal counsel. **It can take days or weeks for lawyers and family members to learn the location of their loved ones, if they can find them at all.** ICE’s online detainee locator is unreliable, untransparent, and unaccountable. And with Border Patrol it can be even worse, with people often never appearing on the locator at all. **That’s why, this week, I introduced the**** _Find Our Families Act_****,** which would require the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to maintain an accurate and detailed online detainee locator system for anyone detained by ICE or CBP. **This locator system must include timely information on abductions, detention locations, and transfers.** For example, more than 1,500 people were just transferred out of ICE’s infamous Alligator Alcatraz facility in the Florida Everglades. Their families and lawyers need immediate knowledge about where their loved ones have been taken, including whether they’ve been deported. **Every day, more of our loved ones are being forcibly disappeared and trafficked into ICE’s unaccountable mass incarceration network, robbing people of their human rights and due process rights.** [**Demand Congress act to hold ICE accountable and support people who’ve been detained, connecting them with their families and legal counsel. Add your name as a grassroots co-sponsor of my**** _Find Our Families Act_****today.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fYoCOM0GhPtGWT4ibJudeUoPVA3-GKSvaWOPx5pQKwnGVZCoth1AsTCMzXzvzrav--t4xLCG4akzGd7NObCKIMelZv4RON2wfD2LG2UdYCdtUldT_p_Zhxs9WKhNOziIIOybNvhyfKFFlRBd_GyeThiO7qUfv_QI8Z3zhWkS4DIvLqSzupXWDnnVFwY7hVvEgceO7NBJ347KHikj680X0ziqvnnD0pznfuDTO5xUR3t27ooDcpTHLWcYZRGSBwRK-mu907cV51PwCTmkV2sGY9FtNGfyaai81l4plKIsllqcEsNk6rudfRYTuMQvDC9zVznI2NCiPslXIdHGiPHjORUmSqyn062v-ZSzEVXeRqoaXaouT7oZrrzogZWqXeQJLSE5p61zNwo2OyYVM9zVPJavdOeCq3unZQGHV4Okr5A/4rn/vgUwEkq5RCe6mPeP_ybqVg/h1/h001.5ToWUWBd2PlsxE1wZWbqRVbk1wmh46Po-AIC7lJABW0) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fYoCOM0GhPtGWT4ibJudeUoPVA3-GKSvaWOPx5pQKwnGVZCoth1AsTCMzXzvzrav--t4xLCG4akzGd7NObCKIMelZv4RON2wfD2LG2UdYCRaraYtz4RTFp3TWpsQkD5tYaPJXaO-ldTYk4YWHqvvrAkfxW6rBec49P1SnCL67dAJYXeYEvN9fPQyAAFMmyO6Q-MNoIqAj-9T8Ga39LbCT20vrbDVaRY1ymhHcWD7SYZfbWWu7rSsDryf1jHlL8QhEiW8ivbWLOIGmZXQ2Yv-AHiYcF8qikSbnyNyhMJOETfUemkfu3PVdQhlBVsAQVnkkmKZr_4r3bBf-u9ChuMoC9MsBHW-ny5cVYexkAxoTIAa1qmdKTA5h5aOypJ0lWatQCTsFIBFDuF-RbopHeI-HEBKiERdMT67Sd83MUrdOPw/4rn/vgUwEkq5RCe6mPeP_ybqVg/h2/h001.iR2y-J8uyW3VUpw-kipzKJNQIL0KLVa2Doa2_6pH3Fk)
---
With access to an attorney, many detainees could be released — because **the Trump administration has no legal justification** to hold people indefinitely.
**But the** **lack of transparency in ICE detention makes it almost impossible for detainees and their loved ones to fight for their freedom.** And that is the point. The administration wants to continue to hold people in inhumane conditions at for-profit prisons, isolated from their families and attorneys.
We can’t let them vanish people.
Our new bill also holds ICE and CBP accountable by including compliance mechanisms, requiring these rogue agencies to inform families and attorneys when someone is transferred or experiences a medical emergency. It mandates visitation access and new public reporting requirements, and penalizes facilities and contractors that don’t comply.

clean_body: This week, I introduced the Find Our Families Act, which would require DHS to maintain an accurate and detailed online detainee locator system for anyone detained by ICE or CBP. | | | Friend, ICE and Border Patrol are abducting our neighbors, locking them in cages, and concealing their location from their families and legal counsel. It can take days or weeks for lawyers and family members to learn the location of their loved ones, if they can find them at all. ICE’s online detainee locator is unreliable, untransparent, and unaccountable. And with Border Patrol it can be even worse, with people often never appearing on the locator at all. That’s why, this week, I introduced the Find Our Families Act, which would require the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to maintain an accurate and detailed online detainee locator system for anyone detained by ICE or CBP. This locator system must include timely information on abductions, detention locations, and transfers. For example, more than 1,500 people were just transferred out of ICE’s infamous Alligator Alcatraz facility in the Florida Everglades. Their families and lawyers need immediate knowledge about where their loved ones have been taken, including whether they’ve been deported. Every day, more of our loved ones are being forcibly disappeared and trafficked into ICE’s unaccountable mass incarceration network, robbing people of their human rights and due process rights. | With access to an attorney, many detainees could be released — because the Trump administration has no legal justification to hold people indefinitely. But the lack of transparency in ICE detention makes it almost impossible for detainees and their loved ones to fight for their freedom. And that is the point. The administration wants to continue to hold people in inhumane conditions at for-profit prisons, isolated from their families and attorneys. We can’t let them vanish people. Our new bill also holds ICE and CBP accountable by including compliance mechanisms, requiring these rogue agencies to inform families and attorneys when someone is transferred or experiences a medical emergency. It mandates visitation access and new public reporting requirements, and penalizes facilities and contractors that don’t comply. Together, we’re equipping families, lawyers, and immigration advocates with the tools we need to free our immigrant neighbors and loved ones from ICE’s cruel and immoral detention system. We’re seeing some victories, such as Trump’s administration backing out of a planned expansion into warehouse detention centers. Our movement is making this happen. We will keep working to fully abolish ICE, end the criminalization of immigration, and build a humane immigration system with pathways to citizenship. **That’s $832 million of YOUR money – handed to an organization that committed 434,450 abortions in a single year.**

That number is up from 402,230 the year before, and up more than 22% in just four years.

**More taxpayer money means more abortions. Period.**

The good news is, the one-year funding pause worked.

Dozens of _Planned Parenthood_ facilities have already closed since President Trump signed the “Big, Beautiful” Budget Bill on July 4th, 2025 – facilities where vulnerable young women are no longer being deceived into killing their preborn babies.

That’s not a failure. That’s proof of concept.

If we can defund them for one year, we can defund them PERMANENTLY.

And we didn’t get here by accident.

_Last year,_Students for Life Action_ ran one of the most aggressive Defund _Planned Parenthood_ campaigns in the history of the Pro-Life Movement_.

I hand-delivered stacks of signed petitions to U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-LA) myself.

I looked those staffers in the eye and told them the _Pro-Life Generation_ is watching, and we vote.

And it worked. The “Big, Beautiful” Budget Bill passed. The funding pause is real.

**They need that taxpayer spigot turned back on – and Saturday, July 4th is the day it automatically restores if Congress sits on its hands.**

That’s just weeks away.

The truth is, the last thing Congress wants is to take a tough vote in an election year – especially on abortion.

But Republicans also know they can’t afford to betray their pro-life base before the November midterms.

**In fact, a February Cygnal poll found that 32% of GOP voters are less likely to vote in the upcoming midterms if they feel that the GOP has abandoned the fight to end abortion.**

In other words, if they don’t deliver for pro-lifers ahead of November, the GOP can kiss their chances of maintaining their power in the midterms goodbye!

**If we don’t, the Abortion Goliath gets a massive gift on America’s 250th birthday – and preborn babies pay the ultimate price.**

We defunded _Planned Parenthood_ once. We can make it permanent.

clean_body: Planned Parenthood defunding expires July 4th. Help us make it permanent before it’s too late. | | | | | | | | | | | Dear Pro-Life Friend, 434,450. That’s how many precious preborn babies Planned Parenthood killed, according to their latest annual report – more than the year before, and more than the year before that. And if Congress does nothing between now and Saturday, July 4th, 2026 – America’s 250th birthday – your tax dollars start flowing right back to the nation’s largest abortion chain. I refuse to let that happen. And I don’t think you will either. My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I’m president of Students for Life Action. We are the biggest thorn in Planned Parenthood’s side because we’re mobilizing young voters – the very demographic the Abortion Goliath targets as “customers” – to end abortion. Students for Life Action is in the fight of our lives to keep Planned Parenthood defunded for good – and we have only weeks to do it. ? Before the defunding took effect last July, the Abortion Goliath was raking in nearly $832 million in government reimbursements and grants every single year. That’s $832 million of YOUR money – handed to an organization that committed 434,450 abortions in a single year. That number is up from 402,230 the year before, and up more than 22% in just four years. More taxpayer money means more abortions. Period. The good news is, the one-year funding pause worked. Dozens of Planned Parenthood facilities have already closed since President Trump signed the “Big, Beautiful” Budget Bill on July 4th, 2025 – facilities where vulnerable young women are no longer being deceived into killing their preborn babies. That’s not a failure. That’s proof of concept. If we can defund them for one year, we can defund them PERMANENTLY. And we didn’t get here by accident. Last year,Students for Life Action ran one of the most aggressive Defund Planned Parenthood campaigns in the history of the Pro-Life Movement. I hand-delivered stacks of signed petitions to U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-LA) myself. I looked those staffers in the eye and told them the Pro-Life Generation is watching, and we vote. And it worked. The “Big, Beautiful” Budget Bill passed. The funding pause is real. But here’s the hard truth – it only lasts one year. And we are running out of time to make it permanent. The good news? Planned Parenthood’s own leadership is already in panic mode. Their annual report admits that up to 200 of their facilities are at risk of closure. They’re so desperate for new revenue that they’ve resorted to selling Botox injections and gender hormones. Their political machine is under serious financial strain for the first time in decades. They need that taxpayer spigot turned back on – and Saturday, July 4th is the day it automatically restores if Congress sits on its hands. That’s just weeks away. The truth is, the last thing Congress wants is to take a tough vote in an election year – especially on abortion. But Republicans also know they can’t afford to betray their pro-life base before the November midterms. In fact, a February Cygnal poll found that 32% of GOP voters are less likely to vote in the upcoming midterms if they feel that the GOP has abandoned the fight to end abortion. In other words, if they don’t deliver for pro-lifers ahead of November, the GOP can kiss their chances of maintaining their power in the midterms goodbye! The ONLY way they find the spine to stand up to the Abortion Lobby is if we FORCE them. If we turn up more heat than Planned Parenthood does, we win. If we don’t, the Abortion Goliath gets a massive gift on America’s 250th birthday – and preborn babies pay the ultimate price. We defunded Planned Parenthood once. We can make it permanent. But only if the Pro-Life Generation shows up again – louder, bigger, and more organized than ever before. So I’m asking you directly: will you make your most generous gift to Students for Life Action today to help us ramp up pressure on Washington, D.C. to defund Planned Parenthood for good? Please prayerfully consider the most generous gift you can make today. The babies don’t have weeks to wait. And neither do we. For Life, Kristan Hawkins President, Students for Life Action P.S. – The one-year pause on taxpayer funding for Planned Parenthood expires on Saturday, July 4th – America’s 250th birthday. Without a groundswell from pro-lifers like you, self-proclaimed “pro-life” politicians will try to skate by, do nothing, and cruise to re-election in November. Your gift today helps prove to them that inaction would be political suicide. ? Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax-deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

body:
This month, we’re celebrating our fierce LGBTQ+ candidates who are changing what the face of power looks like in the Democratic Party.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260620-1&t=1&akid=3621%2E587540%2EnbXRmZ)
**Happy Pride Month, Peter!** 🏳️🌈
This month, we’re celebrating our fierce LGBTQ+ candidates who are changing what the face of power looks like in the Democratic Party.
Leaders We Deserve is incredibly proud to back these candidates. They’re running to make history and fight hard for working people in every corner of the country:
⭐ **Bentley Hudgins** — Georgia HD-90. They stopped every anti-LGBTQ+ bill Georgia Republicans introduced in 2024 and they’ll make history as the first non-binary person ever elected to the Georgia State House.
⭐ **Christian Phelps** — Wisconsin AD-93. He flipped a seat Republicans held for 14 years and sits as Vice-Chair of the Wisconsin Legislative LGBTQ+ Caucus.
⭐ **Spencer Dixon** — Maryland HD-32. He’s taking on corporate money flooding local politics and fighting to make housing affordable for working Marylanders.
⭐ **Armando Montero** — Arizona LD-12. He’s the youngest openly LGBTQ+ member in his district’s history and at just 19 years old, helped develop and adopt a first-of-its-kind mental health policy that transformed the way services are delivered to students and families.
⭐ **Demi Palecek** — Illinois HD-13. She would be the first openly queer woman to represent her district and she’s been on the frontlines defending trans soldiers’ rights, standing up to Trump’s illegal war in Iran, and protecting immigrant communities from ICE’s terror.
⭐ **Molly Cook** — Texas SD-15. She’s the first openly queer person ever elected to the Texas State Senate, and she’s been a relentless advocate for healthcare access ever since.
⭐ **Tim Hayes** — Pennsylvania HD-143. He made history at 21 as the first openly LGBTQ+ member of Dublin Borough Council. Since then, he’s secured millions for land conservation, clean energy, and sustainable farming across his community.
⭐ **Cat Clayton** — Missouri HD-105. She’s running to bring a fresh perspective to Jefferson City, where she’ll fight to protect LGBTQ+ rights, strengthen public schools, and lower costs for working families.
The LGBTQ+ community has always been on the frontlines of our fights, and for decades the establishment did everything they could to lock them out of power. But because of the courage and sacrifice of thousands of activists and organizers, young LGBTQ+ people are being elected across the country. **These leaders are carrying that legacy forward.**
**[Will you celebrate Pride Month with us by splitting a $5 donation between Leaders We Deserve and our candidates?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260620_1_pride.XR6XwB&refcode=em20260620-3621&amount=5&t=2&akid=3621%2E587540%2EnbXRmZ)**

David Hogg

body:
Republicans want people to think that the SPLC is targeting mainstream conservative individuals and groups.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260620-6373-footer&t=1&akid=6373%2E420207%2Exbee7b)
Peter,
Since Donald Trump re-entered the White House, his administration has been relentlessly going after their perceived political enemies — even going so far as to charge the _Southern Poverty Law Center_ with fraud.
Meanwhile, Republicans in Congress have been cheering them on. They even held a hearing in Congress where MAGA-friendly witnesses testified that the SPLC put them on a “domestic terrorist list.” _The SPLC President responded that the organization doesn’t even have such a list._
**I want to be clear: It’s Donald Trump himself who has used extreme rhetoric and gone out of his way to stoke racism, fear, and xenophobia.**
He has denounced Mexican immigrants as rapists, he’s railed against immigration from “shithole countries,” he has enacted travel bans against dozens of countries which a federal court ruled unlawfully targeted people from 39 African, Asian, Latin American, and Middle Eastern countries. And he and Republicans have tried to end birthright citizenship and have given hundreds of billions of dollars to rogue ICE and CBP agents to kidnap and disappear immigrants of all immigration statuses, including United States citizens.
He’s also praised, pardoned, and condoned extreme white nationalists. In Trump’s America, white supremacists at the Charlottesville rally are “very fine people,” even after images and videos showed participants making Nazi salutes and cheering on the former Grand Wizard of the KKK. He then urged the same network of extremists to storm the capitol, and is still trying to implement his $1.8 billion slush fund to pardon convicted insurrectionists.
Now he’s going after the Southern Poverty Law Center because they have dared to call out that extremism, including from people in the White House like Stephen Miller and others within the administration.
**I refuse to stay silent about this, and I’m going to continue calling out Trump and his MAGA allies for their blatant targeting of progressive and civil rights organizations.**

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

clean_body: Make your first gift today and receive a FREE "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Friend, I want to start with two simple words. Thank you. Thank you for caring about children you may never meet. Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold. Because that is exactly what is happening. Every day. God's children are not for sale. And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth. When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store. You can't buy it online. It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say: "No more." Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters. A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity. And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see. Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself. A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children. Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission. Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold. Families were being torn apart. Lives were being destroyed. I couldn't forget it. I couldn't stay silent. I kept asking myself one question: "What if it were my child?" That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom. Not for fame. Not for awards. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed. Studios walked away. People told us to give up. But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option. And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Our mission is simple: To stop the sale of God's children. Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is precious in God's eyes. Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth. And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them When you make your first gift today, you help: Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children. Support intervention efforts by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation. Educate parents and communities about the warning signs traffickers use to target children. Raise awareness so more people understand the reality of this crisis. Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers. This is how change happens. One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet. Today, that person can be you. Will you make your first gift now? Choose your shirt size and select a color. And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most. Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children. Thank you for choosing action over silence. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Your FREE "God's Children Are Not For Sale**" t-shirt is available only for a limited time and only while supplies last. Please make your first gift today, choose your size, and join a growing movement committed to protecting vulnerable children. Every child matters. Every child deserves freedom. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

name: No Weapons to Israel via Our Revolution
subject: Tell Congress – NO to Section 224
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Right now, Congress is trying to sneak through a TERRIFYING new law to
give the Israeli military unprecedented access to U.S. weapons and
technology – and they’re hoping we won’t notice.

Buried in the 500+ pages of this year’s National Defense Authorization Act
(NDAA) is Section 224 – a provision written by lobbyists and Netanyahu
himself that would all but fuse the U.S. and Israeli militaries, with
practically no public oversight. It would hardwire our military support
STRAIGHT into Israel’s ongoing campaigns of mass violence in Gaza and
Lebanon – where tens of thousands of civilians have been killed or
injured.

Long-time Our Revolution ally Rep. Ro Khanna tried to fight it in
committee – but it passed anyway. So now we have to stand with Ro and
Bernie and take the fight to all of Congress to show massive opposition.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39085?source=email-20260620&t=1011&akid=10923%2E5885482%2EbnTQGn ]Bernie tweet: Netanyahu is lobbying for Section 224 in the national
defense bill, a provision that quietly expands US-Israel military
cooperation and weapons development with almost zero oversight. The
American people do not want more US military aid to Israel. We must defeat
Section 224.

Thousands of Our Revolution supporters are speaking out, and bipartisan
concern is growing in Congress. Together, we can stop this backroom deal
from becoming law and refuse to let our government be complicit in further
atrocities.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39085?source=email-20260620&t=1012&akid=10923%2E5885482%2EbnTQGn ]Send an urgent message right now straight to Congress. Tell your
Representatives to REJECT Section 224 and demand public accountability
before it’s too late.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39085?source=email-20260620&t=1013&akid=10923%2E5885482%2EbnTQGn ]ADD YOUR NAME

Section 224 would supersize weapons deals, surveillance tech, and
intelligence sharing for years to come, no matter what voters might want.
It would strip away even the limited Congressional checks that exist
today, making the U.S.-Israel military partnership more secretive, less
accountable, and even harder for the public – or even Congress itself – to
monitor.

It comes as a growing majority of Americans – across party lines – oppose
unconditional support for the Israeli government in the midst of mass
violence. Right now, Congress should be wrestling with the moral and
strategic cost of our military complicity in Gaza and Lebanon – not
writing it into law.

That’s why a bipartisan group of leaders, including Bernie, Rep. Khanna,
and Rep. Thomas Massie, are standing up and vowing to stop Section 224 –
but they can’t do it alone.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39085?source=email-20260620&t=1014&akid=10923%2E5885482%2EbnTQGn ]Headline: Sanders says we must strip Section on US-Israeli military
integration from Pentagon budget.

This moment is our chance. Section 224 was written in the shadows, but
public pressure has already forced lawmakers to pay attention. Your voice
can tip the balance.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39085?source=email-20260620&t=1015&akid=10923%2E5885482%2EbnTQGn ]Don’t let Section 224 slip through on our watch. Take two minutes to
send an urgent message to your members of Congress now and tell them: NO
more blank checks for war.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution
